pages.text: Several mods grow more food. $(thing)Mama's Herbs and Harvest$() adds herbs, vegetables, fruit trees, cheese and butter. $(thing)Berry Good$() improves berries. $(thing)Better Farming Right Click$() saves you replanting time.

pages.title: Mama's Herbs and Harvest
pages.text: Dozens of crops: basil, mint, corn, oats, garlic, ginger, cucumber, celery and more. Fruit trees such as lemon, orange and peach. Jars, pans and a cake stand for serving.

pages.title: Cheese and Butter
pages.text: A Cheesemaking Cauldron, Cheese Aging Shelf and Butter Churn make dairy products over time. Baking pans make lasagna, meatloaf and lamb.

pages.title: Berry Good
pages.text: Makes sweet berries less annoying to eat and adds berry foods: baskets, pips, meatballs, glowgurt and more.

$(bold)Better Farming Right Click$() lets you right-click a mature crop to harvest and replant it in one go. Toggle it from its in-game options; there is also a no-cooldown setting for tools and seeds.$(br2)Rice, tomatoes and onions come from $(l:food/farmers_delight)Farmer's Delight$(/l).

Seasons matter for crops. Serene Seasons ties growth to the calendar, so many crops struggle out of season; plan farms around it. Seasonal Integration extends this to other mods.$(br2)See $(l:survival/seasons)Seasons$(/l). Create farms: $(l:food/integrated_farming)Integrated Farming$(/l).
